source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Abdulbari,

I think this is the strongest version yet. The optical drawing approach made a significant difference, and the letterforms now feel much more cohesive as a family.

I'd like to begin exploring the material and color treatment while we continue refining the wordmark.

I'm attaching this image only as inspiration for the champagne gold color and finish—not the 50/50 black and gold split. I'm drawn to the richness, warmth, and subtle metallic quality of the gold, and I'd love to see how that material language could be incorporated into the VELLVÉ wordmark.

I don't have a predetermined solution in mind, so I'd love to see your interpretation. My only goal is to preserve the timeless, architectural feel we've been building while introducing a refined champagne gold that feels luxurious rather than flashy.

decisions.reason: The move into champagne-gold material and color exploration necessarily makes the accent's black-and-white, no-color exploration format obsolete.
